implementation_summary: Full answer-lifecycle UX for A2UI surfaces, mirroring the legacy ChatAiInteractiveBlock semantics. ChatA2uiBlock now takes {message, indexes, isFormEditing, onSubmitted} (same contract as the legacy block) and derives its state from the surface id: findCreatedSurfaceId(envelopes) (new helper in src/a2ui/envelopes.ts, first createSurface payload) is matched against every user turn's a2uiAction.action.surfaceId; the LAST history group carrying such a turn is the answer turn (so a re-answer that replaces that turn resolves to the newest answer), and within it the last matching item is the submitted turn. Derived states: submitted = answer turn exists; isUnansweredAtEdge = !submitted && indexes.historyIndex === history.length - 1; stale = unanswered but behind the live edge; busy = any history item inProgress. isSurfaceActive = !isChatBusy && (isFormEditing || isUnansweredAtEdge) — identical shape to ChatAiInteractiveBlock:76-78. handleAction returns early unless active, calls onSubmitted() and passes replaceHistoryIndex = answerTurnIndex when re-answering (store parameter already existed). Read-only lock is DOM-level as well as logical: the surfaces render inside <fieldset disabled className="contents pointer-events-none"> (display:contents keeps layout, disabled covers native controls, inherited pointer-events covers the custom DS controls). Prefill: useA2uiSurface gained an optional third argument prefillDataModel; after the server envelopes are replayed it feeds the SAME processor one extra envelope per created surface — {version:'v0.9.1', updateDataModel:{surfaceId, path:'/', value: structuredClone(saved)}} — so an answered surface shows exactly what the user submitted; the value is memoized in ChatA2uiBlock (shallow copy of the frozen valtio snapshot) so the replay memo (keyed on [envelopes, prefillDataModel]) does not rerun per render, and stays null for live surfaces. Pressed-control mark: new src/a2ui/submittedAction.tsx exposes A2uiSubmittedActionProvider/useA2uiSubmittedAction ({name, componentId}); ChatA2uiBlock wraps the surfaces with the submitted action (from a2uiAction.action) and ButtonRenderer compares context.componentModel.id with it, emitting data-testid="a2ui-selected-<actionName>" on the DS button (React context is used because the A2UI binder owns the tree between the chat block and leaf renderers). Re-answer entry point: ChatAiMessage.handleStartEditing now unlocks the form for a2uiEnvelopes messages too (setIsFormEditing(true)) and passes indexes/isFormEditing/onSubmitted down to ChatA2uiBlock. ChatUserMessage renders a compact '✓ <displayText>' chip (data-testid="a2ui-response-chip") for turns carrying a2uiAction, and the raw-body branch now excludes them. Free-text input is untouched — only the surface itself locks.
